from pprint import pprint

new_tab('file:///tmp/u19210/luna-book-r1-controller/index.html')
wait_for_load()


def metrics():
    return js(\"\"\"(() => {
      const text = s => document.querySelector(s)?.textContent.trim() || '';
      const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-bench=\"folio-pair\"]')].map(el => ({
        height: Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().height),
        text: el.innerText.trim(),
        lines: [...el.querySelectorAll('dd')].map(dd => Math.round(dd.getBoundingClientRect().height / parseFloat(getComputedStyle(dd).lineHeight)))
      }));
      const hierarchy = ['context','target','evidence','state','action'].map(role => document.querySelector("'`[data-bench-decision-role="${role}"]`)?.getBoundingClientRect().height > 0);
      return {
        viewport: [window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight],
        visualScale: window.visualViewport?.scale || 1,
        pageWidth: document.documentElement.scrollWidth,
        clientWidth: document.documentElement.clientWidth,
        rows,
        hierarchy,
        active: document.activeElement?.id || document.activeElement?.textContent?.trim() || '"'',
        bindings: [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-bench=\"binding-option\"]')].map(b => [b.dataset.binding, b.getAttribute('aria-pressed')]),
        creep: document.querySelector('[data-bench=\"creep-toggle\"]').getAttribute('aria-pressed'),
        state: text('[data-bench-decision-role=\"state\"]'),
        status: text('[data-bench=\"form-status\"]')
      };
    })()\"\"\")


def set_viewport(width, height, scale=1):
    cdp('Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride', {'width': width, 'height': height, 'deviceScaleFactor': 1, 'mobile': False})
    cdp('Emulation.setPageScaleFactor', {'pageScaleFactor': scale})
    return metrics()

capture_screenshot()
results = {}
results['390'] = set_viewport(390, 844)
results['320'] = set_viewport(320, 720)
results['200pct'] = set_viewport(390, 844, 2)

set_viewport(390, 844)
# Exercise each binding method through visible controls.
for binding in ['perfect', 'saddle', 'sewn']:
    rect = js(f\"(() => {{ const r = document.querySelector('[data-binding=\\\\\\\"{binding}\\\\\\\"]').getBoundingClientRect(); return {{x:r.x+r.width/2,y:r.y+r.height/2}}; }})()\")
    capture_screenshot()
    click_at_xy(rect['x'], rect['y'])
    capture_screenshot()

# Toggle creep compensation and verify the state.
rect = js(\"(() => { const r = document.querySelector('[data-bench=\\\\\\\"creep-toggle\\\\\\\"]').getBoundingClientRect(); return {x:r.x+r.width/2,y:r.y+r.height/2}; })()\")
capture_screenshot()
click_at_xy(rect['x'], rect['y'])
capture_screenshot()

# Submit empty, then focus and submit the requested valid name.
submit = js(\"(() => { const r = document.querySelector('[data-primary-action]').getBoundingClientRect(); return {x:r.x+r.width/2,y:r.y+r.height/2}; })()\")
capture_screenshot()
click_at_xy(submit['x'], submit['y'])
empty_result = metrics()
field = js(\"(() => { const r = document.querySelector('[data-bench=\\\\\\\"job-name\\\\\\\"]').getBoundingClientRect(); return {x:r.x+r.width/2,y:r.y+r.height/2}; })()\")
click_at_xy(field['x'], field['y'])
type_text('Atlas field guide signature')
capture_screenshot()
click_at_xy(submit['x'], submit['y'])
valid_result = metrics()

# Verify keyboard-visible focus styling on the active form control.
focus_result = js(\"(() => { const el=document.querySelector('[data-bench=\\\\\\\"job-name\\\\\\\"]'); el.focus(); const s=getComputedStyle(el); return {active:document.activeElement.id, outline:s.outlineStyle, outlineWidth:s.outlineWidth, outlineColor:s.outlineColor}; })()\")

pprint({'viewports': results, 'empty_submit': empty_result, 'valid_submit': valid_result, 'focus': focus_result})
PY"
